name: HEARKEN
short_description: A blind co-op horror comedy for up to 4 players. Sound is your only sight: every step, clap and scream lights up the dark — and calls a monster that hunts by ear and can call you in your friend's voice. Sneak, haul fragile vials, and scream at the worst possible moment.

name: Soldier Rush
short_description: Soldier Rush is a top-down auto-shooter roguelite: dodge waves while your gun auto-fires at the nearest enemy, beat bosses, and grow stronger between runs. Prestige for crystals, ascend to keep key upgrades, and push into endless loops of enemies. Climb the leaderboards.
reasons: 成長/積み上げ要素: Roguelite +10

name: New Frontier9
short_description: Scout the unknown, choose a route, and load a freighter whose weight changes how it flies. Then take the controls and survive the path you planned in a side-scrolling delivery shooter where safer choices protect the cargo—and danger pays.

name: Nobody Clocks Out
short_description: A retro 2.5D heist shooter set in an office tower after closing. Fight your way up 26 floors of armed night security, win your next gun at the slot machine, and shoot straight through walls that were never built to stop a bullet, from a blowgun on floor one to rocket launchers at the top.

name: Gentle Night
short_description: Master primal desires in a wasteland. Gentle Night is an adult horror Visual Novel you just CAN'T MISS. As Store Manager in a perilous town, will you embrace dominance and corruption? Experience intense taboo, moans, and survival. In this eternal night, their fates are entirely in your hands.

name: The Demon Lurking in Osaka Castle – Episode 1
short_description: A live-action horror visual novel set in Osaka Castle Park. Explore the park after dark, make choices, and uncover a disturbing supernatural mystery through footage filmed on location in Osaka.

name: 灵兽问道-MythicalBeast
short_description: Explore mystical lands, hatch spirit beasts, and master the Five Elements in this single-player cultivation RPG. Brew elixirs, forge gear, merge bloodlines, and ascend through five cultivation realms. Choose when to press on or retreat with your loot, then challenge four sects and the final boss.
reasons: 成長/積み上げ要素: Loot +18
成長/積み上げ要素: RPG +10
現在プレイヤー1人以上 +2

name: Demon Lord: Clicker
short_description: A high-fantasy Steam-drop clicker. Click through demon hordes, gear up for idle power, claim real loot, and push the campaign until the Demon Lord falls.
reasons: 成長/積み上げ要素: Loot +18
現在プレイヤー1人以上 +2

name: Touhou: BlackEight
short_description: If there is an anomaly, do not put the lights out. Survive eight nights at Eientei in this first person Touhou Project horror fan game. 99 ruinous anomalies warp the sleeping girls in the dark, and the distance between Reimu, Marisa, Kaguya and Mokou shifts night by night. Exit 8 like, yuri horror.

name: Keine’s Terakoya: A Schoolhouse in Gensokyo
short_description: Play as Keine Kamishirasawa, the half-beast teacher of Gensokyo! Teach humans and yokai, grow their minds, hearts, and bodies, and guide them to graduation. Balance tradition and change, expand your influence, and build your ideal school. Write your legend on the education frontlines!
reasons: 現在プレイヤー1人以上 +2

name: Go
short_description: Play Go on 9×9, 13×13, or 19×19 boards with Chinese or Japanese rules. Learn the fundamentals, challenge local AI, play locally with a friend, study and analyze SGF records, or connect to OGS for online games and spectating.

name: Jolly Roger Jam: Cathraul's Curse
short_description: A pirate platformer with a big heart... and a bigger skull.

name: Take Me in Totality
short_description: An adult romance visual novel set in a Galician village stranded after a total eclipse. Make choices across three distinct routes, navigate community conflict, and pursue relationships with Bruna, Sabela, or Candela as Loureira decides its future.

name: Timefract
short_description: Move through time. Back and forward. Create clones across timelines and cooperate with yourself to solve impossible puzzles.

name: Intercept Line
short_description: You command Ukraine's air defense. Every night — missiles and drone swarms, and always fewer interceptors than targets. By day it's your turn: deep strikes past enemy radars. And when orders aren't enough — take the stick yourself.

name: Pixel Trader
short_description: Pixel Trader is a pixel-art stock market sim where each trading day brings new prices, headlines, and tough calls. Buy and sell fictional tickers, ride earnings and market shocks, and grow your portfolio in Journey scenarios or Endless mode—no real money at risk.

name: Blackout
short_description: Blackout is an indie puzzle game inspired by old-school handheld games from the 80s and 90s. 5x5 grid only able to be solved by a 3x3 cross/plus.

name: Airline Empire
short_description: Skyline Empire is a turn-based airline tycoon. Found your carrier, connect 300+ real cities, and secure airport slots while competing with up to 100 AI airlines. Set fares, buy aircraft, build hubs, and form alliances to grow a regional startup into a worldwide megacarrier.
reasons: 現在プレイヤー1人以上 +2

name: Washington in Blood
short_description: 《Washington in Blood》 is a near‑future Western fantasy interactive narrative game. Within Washington, ruled by vampire elites, players strive to overthrow the vampire empire. Gather evidence and make critical choices to steer the story toward distinct endings.
reasons: 現在プレイヤー1人以上 +2

name: Snow War
short_description: Neon lights, big hair, and mountains of snow — the 80s never ended in the frozen world of Snow War. Grab your snowballs, gear up with homemade gadgets, and dive into fast‑paced, retro‑flavored action.

name: The Webring
short_description: An Old Internet experience by someone who loved being there.

name: LUPKAR - World of Billiards
short_description: Online billiards with honest physics: Russian pyramid, 8-ball, 9-ball and snooker. 1v1 matches and a four-player table against players worldwide, cross-play with mobile, and full cue control — follow, draw and side spin.
reasons: 現在プレイヤー1人以上 +2

name: Hazard Ready
short_description: Walk a working industrial site, read the actual paperwork, isolate and verify real-feeling equipment with your own hands, and see exactly how a skipped step turns into an incident.

name: BEYOND XII
short_description: Reality is breaking — and the clock is counting down. Explore impossible worlds, uncover the connection between them, and survive as each strike of midnight pulls you deeper into something you were never meant to find.

name: Draw Alive: Fish
short_description: Draw a fish, turtle, jellyfish or crab on paper, snap a photo, and bring it to life in a living 3D aquarium. Import your hand-drawn creatures, decorate coral reefs, and watch your tank teem with marine life.

name: Myriad Gambit
short_description: Myriad Gambit is a mythic Chinese auto battler. Pick a hero, recruit across 8 shifting tribes, and master a 7-slot formation against 7 AI rivals. Upgrade units into golden True Forms, cast spells, and adapt builds to conquer multi-phase Hell boss trials.

name: Horde is Coming
short_description: Your heroes never move. The horde never stops coming. Create insane builds, position your team, combine runes, and unleash two powerful abilities at the perfect moment to survive increasingly brutal waves of monsters.

name: The Fortress Within
short_description: The Fortress Within is an interactive psychological mystery. Enter Xinghe Psychology Clinic and uncover sealed memories through empathic dives, memory analysis, and emotional intervention. Every choice reshapes relationships, clues, and the ending.

name: TimoS
short_description: SteamOS coming soon! Operate your Windows PC in VR with only your head. Built for people who can't use controllers, but useful to those who can! Go hands free in more casual experiences. Gaze-and-dwell cursor, radial menu, on-screen keyboard, for the SteamVR dashboard and your Windows desktop.

name: The 3AM Convenience Store
short_description: Every night at exactly 3 AM, a mysterious customer visits your convenience store. Seven quiet nights of conversation — and your choices — will uncover her secret and decide which of 6 endings you reach. A short, heartfelt visual novel set in the stillness of dawn.
